description: This file is a test script for Git, verifying behaviors related to cloning and fetching from promisor remotes, with special conditions such as custom upload packs and lazy fetching.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes a shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, and verifies failure.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a specified path is a file.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with specified content.
